'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Bombing of Kherson (2022–present)|Bombing of Kherson]]
****A [[civilian]] is killed and five others are injured by a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[airstrike]] on a [[Kherson]] hospital. [https://news.yahoo.com/1-killed-5-injured-russian-133335203.html (''The Kyiv Independent'' via Yahoo! News)]
**[[2022–2023 western Russia attacks]]
***Russia says that it destroyed three [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] near [[Moscow]]. One drone damaged the 21st floor of the [[IQ-quarter]] mixed-use complex, which hosts offices for the [[Ministry of Economic Development (Russia)|Ministry of Economic Development]]. The [[Vnukovo International Airport]] temporarily closed for the second time in two days. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/aug/01/moscow-hit-by-fresh-drone-strike-says-mayor (''The Guardian'')] [https://meduza.io/feature/2023/08/01/novaya-ataka-dronov-na-moskvu-bespilotnik-vnov-vrezalsya-v-bashnyu-moskva-siti (''Meduza'')]
***[[Turkmenistan Airlines]] announces that they will temporarily suspend flights from [[Ashgabat]] to [[Moscow]] following the [[drone attack]]s. Flights will instead travel to [[Kazan]], located in [[Tatarstan]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/08/02/turkmenistan-halts-moscow-flights-amid-drone-attacks-a82032 (''The Moscow Times'')] [https://turkmenportal.com/blog/65243/aviakompaniya-turkmenistan-soobshchila-o-priostanovlenii-reisov-po-marshrutu-ashhabad--moskva--ashhabad (Turkmenportal)]
*[[Religious violence in India]]
**[[2023 Haryana riots]]
***A deputy [[imam]] is killed and another is injured when [[Hinduism in India|Hindus]] storm a [[mosque]] in [[Gurgaon]], [[Haryana]], [[India]], as a spillover of yesterday's intercommunal violence in the neighboring [[Nuh district]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/1/imam-killed-after-hindu-mob-attacks-mosque-in-indias-gurugram (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Protest]]s begin in [[Kadugli]], [[South Kordofan]], [[Sudan]], against the ongoing clashes in the city, with protesters also [[anti-war movement|denouncing the war]] and the country's [[gender inequality in Sudan|violations against women]]. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/marches-as-splm-n-el-hilu-and-army-clash-in-south-kordofan (Dabanga Sudan)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Palestinian]] man is shot and killed by [[Israeli security forces]] after opening fire on [[Israelis]] in the [[Israeli settlement|settlement]] of [[Ma'ale Adumim]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/1/palestinian-opens-fire-in-west-bank-settlement-wounding-israelis (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Decommunization in Ukraine]]
**The [[State Emblem of the Soviet Union|Soviet state emblem]] emblazoned on the ''[[Motherland Monument]]'' statue in [[Kyiv]] is removed and will be replaced with the ''[[Coat of arms of Ukraine|tryzub]]''. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/08/02/world/americas-emea/hammer-sickle-removed-from-giant-kyiv-statue/1903529 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Big Three (credit rating agencies)|Major]] [[credit rating agency]] [[Fitch Ratings|Fitch]] downgrades the [[United States]]' [[bond credit rating]] from AAA to AA+, citing an "erosion of governance" manifested in the country's [[United States debt ceiling|debt ceiling]] impasses. [https://www.ft.com/content/63e410d0-9e4e-4b28-b0dd-f4d1f093dc6a (''Financial Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Doksuri (2023)|Typhoon Doksuri]]
***Eleven people are killed and 13 others are reported missing during [[flood]]s in [[Beijing]], [[China]]. More than 50,000 people have been [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] from the city. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-66369137 (BBC News)]
*Twenty workers are killed and three others are injured when a large [[Crane (machine)|crane]] collapses at a [[highway]] [[Construction|construction site]] in [[Thane]], [[Maharashtra]], [[India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/1/workers-crushed-to-death-as-crane-collapses-at-india-road-construction-site (Al Jazeera)]
*One person is killed and 56 others are injured after a tour bus rolls over in [[Grand Canyon West, Arizona| Grand Canyon West]], [[Arizona]], [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/one-killed-56-injured-bus-rolls-over-near-grand-canyon-2023-08-02/ (Reuters)]
'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 Asia heat wave]]
**The [[Government of Iran|Iranian government]] declares a two-day nationwide holiday due to [[heat wave|extreme heat]], closing all schools, banks, and government offices. [https://news.sky.com/story/iran-announces-nationwide-shutdown-due-to-soaring-heat-12931849 (Sky News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2023 Nigerien coup d'état]]
**[[France]] and [[Italy]] begin the evacuation of their citizens and other [[Europe]]an nationals from [[Niger]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/1/france-to-begin-evacuation-for-its-citizens-eu-nationals-in-niger (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea]]
**The [[Senate of the Philippines]] adopts a resolution condemning [[China]]'s incursions in the [[West Philippine Sea]] and urges the [[Department of Foreign Affairs (Philippines)|Department of Foreign Affairs]] to file a resolution regarding China's harassment of [[Philippines|Philippine]] vessels before the [[United Nations General Assembly]]. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/877567/senate-adopts-resolution-strongly-condemning-chinese-incursions/story/ (GMA News)]
*[[Belarus–Poland relations]]
**[[Poland]] orders an increase in the number of soldiers near [[Belarus–Poland border|its border with Belarus]] after the Polish [[Ministry of National Defence (Poland)|Ministry of National Defence]] says two [[Belarus]]ian helicopters that were carrying out training exercises violated its airspace. [https://apnews.com/article/poland-belarus-helicopters-wagner-37ce52ace946a0f651ce1e4a3f6ee7eb (AP)]
*[[Foreign relations of Burundi]], [[Foreign relations of Russia]]
**[[Burundi]] and [[Russia]] sign a [[memorandum of understanding|memorandum of cooperation]] on sharing [[nuclear technology]] for peaceful purposes at the  Russia-Africa Economic and Humanitarian Forum in [[Saint Petersburg]], Russia. [https://www.world-nuclear-news.org/Articles/Burundi-and-Ethiopia-among-Russia-Africa-nuclear-c (World Nuclear News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election]]
**[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack]], [[United States Justice Department investigation into attempts to overturn the 2020 presidential election|US DOJ investigation on the 2020 presidential election]]
***Former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] is indicted by [[United States Department of Justice|DOJ]] Counsel [[Jack Smith (lawyer)|Jack Smith]] on four criminal counts as part of [[Federal prosecution of Donald Trump (election obstruction case)|an investigation]] for his role in attempting to overturn the [[2020 United States presidential election]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/08/01/trump-indicted-again-00109286 (Politico)] [https://fortune.com/2023/08/01/trump-charged-doj-overturn-2020-presidential-election-loss/?ref=biztoc.com (Fortune)]
**Two members of the [[Michigan Republican Party]] are [[criminal charge|charged]] by [[prosecutor]]s for attempting to tamper with [[voting machine]]s in [[Michigan]] during [[2020 United States presidential election in Michigan|the 2020 election]]. [https://apnews.com/article/matthew-deperno-michigan-trump-voting-machines-a58c4a58de84d432815ec1be39c19b90 (AP)]
*Two people are killed and five others are injured when an assailant robs passengers and throws a [[Molotov cocktail]] on a bus in [[Dakar]], [[Senegal]]. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/miscellaneous/two-dead-in-senegal-bus-petrol-bomb-attack-1732664.html (AFP via UrduPoint)]
*Suspended [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|Filipino congressman]] and alleged mastermind of the [[Pamplona massacre]] [[Arnolfo Teves Jr.]] and twelve others are designated as [[terrorist]]s by the [[Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020|Anti-Terrorism Council]]. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/877515/anti-terrorism-council-designates-arnie-teves-12-others-as-terrorists/story/ (GMA News)]
*[[Myanmar]]'s former leader [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] is [[pardon]]ed on five of her [[conviction]]s, thereby reducing her prison [[sentence (law)|sentence]] from 33 to 27 years. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20230801-myanmar-s-ousted-leader-suu-kyiv-has-some-of-her-prison-sentences-reduced (AFP via France 24)]
*The [[Public Prosecutor of Costa Rica]] launches an [[influence peddling]] investigation into [[President of Costa Rica|President]] [[Rodrigo Chaves Robles]] and several other [[Government of Costa Rica|government]] officials. [https://www.newvision.co.ug/category/news/costa-rica-president-investigated-for-influen-NV_166516 (AFP via ''New Vision'')]
